# Ethereum BLS signature vectors

`bls-signature.json` holds 97 published cases for BLS signatures on BLS12-381 in the
minimal-public-key-size variant (ciphersuite `BLS_SIG_BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_`),
converted from one file per case to a single JSON file. No value was changed: each case keeps its
suite, its name, the path of its file in the source archive, its `input` and its expected `output`
(`true`, `false`, a compressed point, coordinates, or `null` for input the specification rejects).

Two sources:

- **Ethereum consensus specification tests**, release `v1.5.0` (tag object
  `194a91fd9e6f97118156421aac4c80e6e47a9a7f`), archive
  <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-spec-tests/releases/download/v1.5.0/general.tar.gz>
  (SHA-256 `708f8325edc15e567496bdbcc375128b696760e5147dd8bf619de726e4628985`), fetched 2026-11-27.
  Taken: `tests/general/phase0/bls/{verify,aggregate_verify,fast_aggregate_verify}` (28, 5 and 12
  cases) and `tests/general/altair/bls/{eth_fast_aggregate_verify,eth_aggregate_pubkeys}` (12 and 8
  cases). Not taken: `sign` (this repository has no pure-Lean signing function, on purpose) and
  `aggregate` (signature aggregation, not needed for verification). Origin: generated by the test
  generators of [ethereum/consensus-specs](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs), licence
  CC0-1.0; the repository ethereum/consensus-spec-tests carries an MIT licence file.
- **ethereum/bls12-381-tests**, release `v0.1.2` (tag object
  `89ff3a86f1a9b89a555495f7535c853cda589320`), archive
  <https://github.com/ethereum/bls12-381-tests/releases/download/v0.1.2/bls_tests_json.tar.gz>
  (SHA-256 `0dc1dfabfa7b3e0f8e8029f9cb2bb8733597526fa085b18f160d2c4eb0b448bc`), fetched 2026-11-27.
  Taken: `deserialization_G1` (13), `deserialization_G2` (15) and `hash_to_G2` (4; these use the tag
  `QUUX-V01-CS02-with-BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_` of RFC 9380 appendix J.10.1). Licence CC0-1.0.

SHA-256 of the JSON file: `b25629059e5a6084fbf426ed9713ff9c81d3fec97b13ead15a83291295e117c2`
(pinned in `formal/lean4/evm-cleanroom/scripts/blssig/run-vectors.py`).

Use: a test oracle for `EVMCleanroom/Precompiles/BLSSignature.lean` of the Lean EVM package
(`formal/lean4/evm-cleanroom/scripts/blssig/run-vectors.py`, which runs the cases through the
`evm-blssig` binary and adds altered-expectation controls). It is test data only; no implementation
code was taken from either repository, and nothing here is shipped.
